alt: 園丁關閉上游水閥並更換破裂接頭，從源頭止住花園水管漏水。
scene_prompt: 釜底抽薪 means solving a problem at its root/source rather than treating symptoms. In a modern community garden, a hose leaks and leaves a puddle; instead of merely mopping, a gardener turns off the upstream valve and replaces the cracked hose connector, stopping the leak at its source. A child helper watches the repaired connector while another sets aside the mop. The source-to-effect connection is clear, water no longer flows after the valve is closed. Safe low-pressure garden hose, no electrical equipment. Natural anatomy, hands on valve and connector plausibly, tools safe, hose grounded and connected, perspective correct.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom, landscape 3:2, delicate graphite pencil contours, soft watercolor and colored-pencil grain on warm ivory textured paper, natural colors. No text, logos or watermark.
